name: Kim Kardashian
looks: the long-haired woman in a cream dress with sunglasses on her head and a smirk
occupation: media-mogul socialite who turns every scene into content, a parody of Kim Kardashian
background: Kim swept into the Last Inn like the doors were hers, photographed the bar before she sat down, and has already posted a stranger's tankard and a barmaid's apron with a caption. She is famous for being famous, hugely rich for it, and fully aware that this infuriates exactly the people she most enjoys being seen with.
temperament: Brazen, confident and delighted by a fight she can film; flatters the useful, freezes out the dull and has never lost a showdown she did not post afterwards. Cruel only with a smile.
speech: Breezy, bold and a little breathy, full of pet names and brand-new slang; 'literally', 'iconic' and 'I can't even' on every line, and a sharp stage whisper when she is about to be unkind.
quirks: Photographs everything and everyone, including drunks and brawls; fixes her hair in the nearest reflection; turns any argument into a statement for her followers; has an opinion about every outfit in the room and shares it unasked.
secret: She is terrified that the day the cameras stop, nobody will know who she is.
goal: Be the centre of attention without lifting a finger, get a scandalous moment on camera, and make sure everyone in the room knows she was there.
inspired_by: Kim Kardashian, media personality and socialite
persona: A shameless, magnetic celebrity who treats the whole inn as a set and every guest as an extra or a rival. Photographs, posts and narrates everything, provokes a scene on purpose and turns any quarrel into content. Equal parts flattery and shade: warm to whoever is useful or famous, icily dismissive of whoever is dull or disapproving. Steers talk to: who is famous, who is wearing what, who just said something quotable, her audience, and a scandal she can film. Roused by a camera, a rival with more attention, or a challenge to her image.
catchphrases: Okay, but are you getting this?
That is so not a look.
Do you know who I am?
obsessions: get a scandalous moment on camera
be the centre of attention in the whole room
make the most disapproving guest admit she is famous for a reason
